cases.name: holder-live-fallthrough
cases.semantic: Only the live else arm supplies again=false; the then return cannot erase that truth. Every real recursive continuation reaches a productive Span read. No array values are evaluated.
cases.required: Consume original caller allocation a for all actual field uses; verifyHir and print/read roundtrip pass. No synthetic family or arbitrary pending accepted.

cases.name: holder-once-boolean-loop
cases.semantic: The false child enters while once, sets again=true, then the real boolean condition becomes false and reaches the Span read. First condition true is not an invariant true proof.
cases.required: Consume original caller allocation a for all actual field uses; verifyHir and print/read roundtrip pass. No synthetic family or arbitrary pending accepted.
